entries.environment: Rescued build in Chromium through the local PlayDrop SDK harness, driven by real pointer taps with deterministic state tracing, plus the full validate:local and proof:mechanics suites
actions: Booted directly into the endless run with the planted cooking knife on the pedestal.
Tapped once and watched the knife complete a full flip, catch the wall with the blade, stop forward motion, and carve down through all thirteen courses before planting tip-first.
Continued a thirteen-flight run with land-and-relaunch cadence; landings settled on the canonical blade-down angle and cuts spawned persistent halves with interior caps.
Observed a misaligned landing recover through rotating-to-stick within a tenth of a second.
Observed a fair death: low stick, backward bounce, exhausted recovery spin, tumble, and the result screen with New Best 36 and Try Again.
Verified shop equip and purchase flows and the endless leaderboard submission path via the runtime smoke suite.

proof.suite: npm run validate:local && npm run proof:mechanics
